text: Explain in a short paragraph why the sky is blue.
Write a Python function that returns the n-th Fibonacci number iteratively, with a docstring.
List ten European capitals and their countries, one per line.
Write the opening three sentences of a mystery novel.
Spiega in italiano, in quattro frasi, perché una cache può rendere un programma più veloce e quando non aiuta.
Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists without changing its inputs. Include tests for empty lists and duplicate values.
Repeat this list exactly, one item per line: apple, banana, cherry, dragonfruit, elderberry, fig, grape, honeydew, kiwi, lemon.
First write a Python function that squares a number. Then explain in Italian why its result is non-negative for real inputs. End with one sentence of a detective story.
A box has three red balls and two blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. Explain how to compute the probability they have the same colour.
